item.title: Pluto in Gemini: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Pluto in Gemini means Pluto was in Gemini when you were born. In astrology Pluto stands for where you transform; Gemini is an air sign ruled by Mercury, curious and quick. Your words can excavate what whole conversations bury. Read more at astralroots.app

item.title: Neptune in Aries: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Neptune in Aries means Neptune was in Aries when you were born. In astrology Neptune stands for your dreams and imagination; Aries is a fire sign ruled by Mars, direct and brave. You chase an ideal of courage worth believing in. Read more at astralroots.app

item.title: Uranus in Aquarius: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Uranus in Aquarius means Uranus was in Aquarius when you were born. In astrology Uranus stands for where you break the mould; Aquarius is an air sign ruled by Saturn, with Uranus as its modern ruler, fresh and independent. You are the future's early native speaker. Read more at astralroots.app
